target.title: fix(device-pair): remove INADDR_ANY and IPv6 unspecified from isLoopbackHost
target.body:
## What

Removed `0.0.0.0` (INADDR_ANY) and `::` (IPv6 unspecified) from `isLoopbackHost` in the device-pair extension.

## Why

`0.0.0.0` means "bind to all interfaces" and `::` means "unspecified address" — neither is a loopback address. Classifying them as loopback causes incorrect behavior in mobile pairing cleartext host validation. The canonical implementation in `src/gateway/net.ts` already explicitly excludes both.

## Evidence

- **device-pair tests**: all pass (see test run output below)
- **canonical implementation**: `src/gateway/net.ts` `isLoopbackHost` and `packages/net-policy/src/ip.ts` correctly classify these as NOT loopback
- **net.test.ts**: 49 test cases verify `0.0.0.0` and `::` are NOT loopback in the canonical implementation
